description: Gång- och cykelvägnät is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Botkyrka kommun. Pedestrian and bicycle path network in Botkyrka municipality. Coverage: Botkyrka kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian and cycle path network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Botkyrka kommun. Its keywords include Walkway, Cykelväg, Bicycle path, Gångväg. The listing shows 3 download or service links in KML, JSON, GPKG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
